title: Highlight Babies
description: Adds the ability to highlight baby animals with frozen growth when holding a Golden Dandelion.
body:
**Minecraft 26.1** introduced the ability to **freeze baby animal growth** using the new **Golden Dandelion**. While this is a great feature, it can be hard to tell which baby animals have frozen growth and which are still growing normally.

This datapack solves that problem by adding **visual particle effects** to baby animals with frozen growth whenever you're **holding a Golden Dandelion** in your hand.
